brief:
Discussion of Nikolai Mladenov's role and the Peace Council in Gaza has shifted from debate over failed or weakened mediation efforts to allegations of deeper culpability, Shehab Wire reported. Critics now characterize their activities as political complicity that provides diplomatic cover for Israeli occupation and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to continue military violations and breaches of international law.

The outlet frames the international mediation mechanism as functioning to enable rather than constrain operations in the territory. The characterization marks a hardening of criticism beyond assessments of negotiating failures, treating the envoy and council as active participants in prolonging the conflict rather than neutral intermediaries.
